name: text-tools
description: Three small agent tools compiled to WebAssembly: a slug for a title, counts for a text, and a web page's title. An example of a WASM plugin.

tools.name: slugify
tools.description: Turn a title into a URL slug: lowercase words joined by the separator set for the plugin.

tools.name: stats
tools.description: Count the words, lines, sentences and characters in a piece of text.

tools.name: page_title
tools.description: Fetch a web page and answer its title.

settings.label: Slug separator
settings.help: What joins the words of a slug.
